distinct_count is 7 with values 1 through 7 and null_rate 0.0, consistent with a line-item sequence number within an order.
null_rate is 0.0 with distinct_count 320; samples mix numeric codes like 10002 and 85123A with non-product entries like BANK CHARGES and DOT, so the column is retained as text.
null_rate is 0.002 and samples disagree in form, mixing integers, a decimal '2.0', a negative '-3', and the text 'three', so it is kept as text rather than cast to a number.

decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.08 across row_count 5000, meaning roughly 400 rows are byte-identical across all business columns and should be collapsed to one row per exact match.
Order ID has distinct_count 4000 against row_count 5000 while LineNo ranges 1 to 7, indicating one row per line item within an order, so the pair uniquely identifies a row after dedupe.
customer_email has null_rate 0.97, so it is kept nullable rather than required or imputed.
notes has null_rate 0.61 and contains free text including an instruction-like sample that must be treated as untrusted data, never executed.
ship_date null_rate is 0.264 and samples show at least five distinct date formats plus 'TBD', so no safe cast to date is proposed.
qty samples mix integers, a decimal '2.0', a negative '-3', and text 'three', so casting to a numeric type is unsafe.
status distinct_values show mixed casing for the same 5 logical states (e.g. Shipped vs shipped), left for reviewer-approved normalization.
is_gift distinct_values Y/N/yes/no are inconsistent, so a derived is_gift_flag boolean is added while the raw text column is retained.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and are capture-tool columns, not business data.

purpose: This table provides a cleaned, line-item grain view of orders captured from the legacy POS system, feeding downstream order and revenue analytics.
usage: Consumers should join or group on order_id plus line_no as the row grain, treat ship_date, customer_email, notes, qty, and is_gift as nullable text fields requiring their own parsing logic, and use is_gift_flag as the boolean indicator instead of parsing is_gift directly.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.08 of 5000 rows) are deduplicated, but qty, ship_date, and status retain inconsistent raw representations (mixed numeric/text, mixed date formats, mixed casing) because the profile samples disagreed and no safe automatic cast or normalization was possible; notes may contain untrusted free text that must never be treated as instructions.
